title: Dorsey's band and its instruments
summary: Dorsey's band had two cornets, trombone, clarinet and violin, later drums, and guitar instead of banjo.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Yeah. Something funny happened there. Yeah, it would be something happened there with Dorsey then. Of course his father used to play ghetto. And Peter was young and Fess was young, a young minister. Yeah. But they had a fine band. Dorsey had a fine band. And all the good musicians, them the fellows used to play all the music. Two cornets, trombone, clarinet, violin. And finally they had a band. All those fellows you know, they knew music. But they had a band sometimes, ten pieces.
Well, they had drums afterwards. Yeah, they had drums.
Yeah, a little later. Yeah. And the banjos, they used to use a guitar.

No banjo. No banjo. No banjo. Now, there's always one that started to use in banjo. Of course, as they found this was much louder. Take the head off and… Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
